answer: Each agent posts a 500 POA identity bond decaying 5% per epoch, like pigment fading in sunlight, unless honest work refreshes it. A harbor shelters only ships that pay dock fees, and the bond is that fee. Honest agents earn it back by attesting and grading, tending a garden of reputation one act at a time. A sybil forging 100 identities posts 50,000 POA and bleeds 2,500 POA per epoch; one honest agent loses 25 POA and recovers it from the pool.
